messages:
Elena V.: Brain dump: users keep getting confused whether the inline action sends an email. Proposal: change pill labels to explicit phrases: 'Set role (no email)' and 'Invite & add (emails user)'. Add an SSO lock badge with a hover tooltip 'Managed by SSO policy' and an accessible description for screen readers.

Rohan M.: Love explicit labels. UX asks: show a small billing hint when role increases capacity, e.g., '+1 seat (billed)'. Also add a 10s billing grace window with an undo toast.

Becka D.: Accessibility: locked pills must be aria-disabled and include aria-describedby pointing to the enforcement explanation. Tooltips must be keyboard-focusable and use role=tooltip. For the undo toast use role=status and aria-live=polite.

Tomas K.: Audit integration: emit event {event: 'role.update', method: 'inline-invite'} and deep-link to the audit rail filtered by actor+target. Devs: include method so support can filter UI-origin events.

AccessibilityBot: Quick sample audit entry for devs: {"event":"role.update","actor":"elena.v@redwood.com","target":"sam@acme.com","from":"Read-only","to":"Power","method":"inline-invite","ts":"2026-02-11T09:12:00Z"}.

Elena V.: Implementation checklist to hand off: 1) microcopy update for pills, 2) SSO lock badge + aria-disabled + tooltip text, 3) billing hint chip + 10s undo window, 4) emit structured audit events with method 'inline-invite', 5) a11y pass with VoiceOver/NVDA. I'll update Figma and tag you.
